title: Record routine checks and missed work

scenes.title: Record routine checks and missed work
scenes.narration: Welcome to Resgrid Academy. In this lesson, we will record routine checks and missed work. Paper checks make it difficult to see which apparatus was inspected and which scheduled checks were missed. We will explain the features, the setup decisions, and a practical way to check the result.

scenes.title: A department scenario
scenes.narration: A daily apparatus check is scheduled for each engine, and the weekly compliance report shows any missed checks. Recorded checks show what was inspected and what was missed. The examples in this series use a fictional department and are teaching scenarios, not default settings.

scenes.title: Checklist Templates
scenes.narration: Checklist Templates. Ready-made checklists for common checks. Start from a template or build a checklist for each apparatus.

scenes.title: Checklists
scenes.narration: Checklists. Checklists members complete. Create the checklists members complete on paper today.

scenes.title: Checklist schedules and due work
scenes.narration: Checklist schedules and due work. Recurring schedules and due checks. Schedule each checklist and choose who completes it. Availability also depends on Checklists. Check access in the target department.

scenes.title: New Checklist
scenes.narration: New Checklist. Create a checklist. Pick the checks you do on paper today and who completes them.

scenes.title: Checklist compliance reports
scenes.narration: Checklist compliance reports. Completed, skipped and overdue checks over time. Pick the checks you do on paper today and who completes them. Availability also depends on Checklists. Check access in the target department.

scenes.title: Configure one useful workflow
scenes.narration: For the training scenario, work in this order. Step 1. Start from a checklist template or build the approved checks. Step 2. Assign the checklist and set its recurring schedule. Step 3. Complete a demo check, record a defect, and review compliance.

scenes.title: Verify the result
scenes.narration: Now verify the result. Compare due checks with completed, skipped, and overdue results. Confirm defects have an assigned follow-up owner. A common problem to watch for: A completion report documents recorded checks. A failed item still requires action through the department repair process.

scenes.title: Try it with your department
scenes.narration: Your practice task is simple. Complete a daily Engine 1 check and leave a second demo check overdue. Confirm that the compliance view distinguishes both. Record the result, who owns the follow-up, and when it should be reviewed. Use the linked feature scripts for the detailed screen recording plan.
